report.summary:
PR #10 (https://github.com/paxxie2/b5-off-site-pnl/pull/10) is ready for human review/merge. Branch agent/reject-reverse-window-2-f0707370fc2f, base main, head e301bae.

What changed: backend/app/domain/money.py only (7 insertions, 1 deletion). previous_window now raises ValueError when start_date > end_date, with a docstring documenting the contract. Legal windows, including single-day, same-month, cross-month, leap-year, non-leap February, cross-year and leap-day boundary cases, are unchanged; date_range and all other functions/signatures/dependencies untouched.

Verification actually run:
- Stdlib-only acceptance mirror outside the repo (8 legal windows, 5 reversed windows at day/month/year/leap-day boundaries): baseline 1e166fb fails 3/3 runs with "DID NOT RAISE ValueError" (target assertion failure, not import/dependency error); patched head passes 3/3 runs; legal-window assertions pass on both revisions.
- Repo module imported directly and checked 3/3 runs; explicit ValueError confirmed for reversed inputs and date_range reversed behavior still returns [].
- uv run --offline pytest backend/tests/test_money.py test_pnl.py test_rules.py test_scenarios.py: 49 passed.
- git diff --check clean; PR contains exactly one file.

Pre-existing limitation (unrelated, outside allowed scope): full backend/tests cannot collect test_db.py/test_seed.py and DB-backed API fixtures because backend/app/data is absent from the baseline (data/ is gitignored); they fail with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'app.data' on baseline too.

No CI checks are configured on this repo (statusCheckRollup empty), PR is MERGEABLE/CLEAN, no reviews requested by any repo rule. Auto-merge not enabled (no merge CLI named); a person must merge. Note: open PRs #3, #6 and #8 propose the identical change from earlier independent runs, so only one should be merged. No human reviewers, so no co-author trailers were added/required. Temp verification mirror lives under /tmp/reverse-window-check (outside the repo); repo working tree clean.
